items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: So, the man told them, say, I know two fellas out in Gitts... Rainey, Kid Rainey and his brother, Joe Rainey. So they came and got us, man. We went up in there, man. Kept that house packed.

ctx.x: No? That was a wonderful piano player.

Yeah. Decaugé, yeah. And did you have on there? Yeah. Eh? Decaugé, uh, well, we had, uh, when I went, they had, they got rid of this band. See, because a couple of the musicians quit the thing, and they got rid of them. So, the man told them, say, I know two fellas out in Gitts, I'm gonna see them. He said, that's, uh, Rainey, Kid Rainey and his brother, Joe Rainey. So they came and got us, man. We went up in there, man. Kept that house packed. We kept that house packed for them number of years. Then in 42, well,…
